title: Owl Semaphore Badge System
description: Release candidate. A finite algebra over epistemic states, implemented as a reproducible visual notation system with enforced invariants. The Owl Semaphore provides four classification states (NORMATIVE, NON-NORMATIVE, CRITICAL, METACOGNITIVE) for marking how a claim, document, dataset, or finding should be evaluated before belief, challenge, or action. v1.3.0-rc reconciles canonical wording across the README, system specification, state specifications, citation metadata, and generated PDFs; replaces stale Version 1.0 stamps; adds OWL-SEMAPHORE-EXPLANATION.md (origin story and archetype rationale); adds per-page owl headers, embedded PDF metadata, and a single-command (make pdfs) reproducible PDF build; adds banner-tuple integrity tests verifying state, transform, determinant, mapping, version, and DOI family from the generated PDFs; adds citations for external scientific claims (RFC 2119/8174, V4/O(2), WCAG 2.2, ICD 203, seL4); and refreshes the integrity manifest and SHA-3-512 hash coverage. The V4 algebra, state assignments, transforms, color assignments, and canonical geometry are unchanged. License remains CC BY 4.0.
